author: oracle-method
concept: Strict separation: fleet surfaces state ONLY the merge/receipt-verified fleet record, in fleet voice. Partner claims appear nowhere in fleet copy — partners are named as participants (link live = the assertable fact) with offers stated only as the registry verifies them; unverified offers are dropped, not footnoted. Tactics survive only with measured signal against a pre-set decision rule; unmeasured tactics are killed or instrumented before further spend.
